title: Transfer Employee Badge Clearance Audit
goal: Reconcile archived PDF badge-assignment packets with a multi-sheet Excel clearance workbook, then report employees whose badges were removed, whose access zones changed, or whose clearance levels no longer match policy.
skillBenefitRationale: 把同一组技能迁移到员工门禁审计场景，仍然需要从分段 PDF 表格中提取记录，并跨多个 Excel 工作表做关联、比对和异常汇总。
